name: AiMatch Pro

sources.title: Homepage — live AI tools directory (~6,000+ tools across 45 categories)
List your tool — $29 one-time launch listing via Stripe: permanent page + 30-day sponsored category position
Contact — 'Want to list your tool, suggest an update…' mailto fallback for suggestions

requirements: $29 one-time payment via Stripe for a launch listing
Ownership verification via the submission email; sponsored placement is labeled 'sponsored' for 30 days
Editors verify final title, category, and listing details before publishing
preparation: Contact email — gets the receipt and listing access (not published)
Optional: preferred display name and category; notes
workflow: Open https://aimatch.pro/list ('List your tool' in nav)
Enter company name, website, contact email, optional name/category/notes
Continue to Stripe checkout and pay $29
Editors verify details, then email the live listing link
Sponsored position runs 30 days; the permanent tool page stays live afterward
watchFor: No free listing path — the only documented route is the $29 launch listing
Sponsored placement is explicitly labeled — buyers see it as an ad for 30 days
No traffic or sales guarantee stated on the page
A free 'suggest an update' path exists via /contact for already-listed tools, not new listings
Directory appears aggregator-style (auto-generated tool profiles); editorial depth unknown
countsAsLive: A permanent /tool/name/<slug> page exists on aimatch.pro and the tool occupies a labeled sponsored slot in its category for the first 30 days
unknowns: Whether the outbound link on the permanent page is dofollow
Whether unpaid organic additions happen — no public free submission found
